ORDER GRANTING LIMITED INTERVENTION TO UBLRGWD; ORDER GRANTING IN PART JOINT MOTION FOR TEMPORARY STAY OF CURTAILMENT—1 BEFORE THE DEPARTMENT OF WATER RESOURCES OF THE STATE OF IDAHO IN THE MATTER OF DISTRIBUTION OF WATER TO VARIOUS WATER RIGHTS HELD BY OR FOR THE BENEFIT OF A&B IRRIGATION DISTRICT, AMERICAN FALLS RESERVOIR DISTRICT #2, BURLEY IRRIGATION DISTRICT, MILNER IRRIGATION DISTRICT, MINIDOKA IRRIGATION DISTRICT, NORTH SIDE CANAL COMPANY, AND TWIN FALLS CANAL COMPANY Docket No. CM-DC-2010-001 Docket No. CM-MP-2024-003 ORDER GRANTING LIMITED INTERVENTION TO UBLRGWD ORDER GRANTING IN PART JOINT MOTION FOR TEMPORARY STAY OF CURTAILMENT BACKGROUND On January 3, 2025, the Director of the Idaho Department of Water Resources (“Director”) approved the 2024 Stipulated Mitigation Plan (“2024 Plan”). On reconsideration, the Director amended one of his conclusions of law and issued an amended approval order on February 7, 2025. The signatories to the 2024 Plan consist of A&B Irrigation District, American Falls Reservoir District No. 2, Burley Irrigation District, Milner Irrigation District, Minidoka Irrigation District, North Side Canal Company, and Twin Falls Canal Company (collectively, the “Surface Water Coalition” or “SWC”), and Aberdeen-American Falls Ground Water District, Bingham Ground Water District, Bonneville-Jefferson Ground Water District, Carey Valley Ground Water District, Henry’s Fork Ground Water District, Jefferson-Clark Ground Water District, Madison Ground Water District, Magic Valley Ground Water District, and North Snake Ground Water District (collectively, the “Districts”). 2024 Plan § 1. The 2024 Plan was assigned Department Docket No. CM-MP-2024-003. The 2024 Plan provides ground water districts added to the Eastern Snake Plain Aquifer Area of Common Ground Water Supply (“ESPA ACGWS”) the opportunity to join the plan. Id. § 10. The 2024 Plan expressly directs that: “[u]pon the written consent of all parties, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld, the parties and the entity joining this Plan shall execute an addendum to this Plan . . . .” Id. On December 8, 2025, the Director issued the Final Order Curtailing Ground Water Rights Junior to August 15, 1952 (“Curtailment Order”) in the Surface Water Coalition Delivery Call, assigned Department Docket No. CM-DC-2010-001. On April 14, 2026, the Districts filed Existing Participating Districts’ Motion for Approval of First Addendum to 2024 Stipulated Mitigation Plan and for Stay of Curtailment (“Districts’ Motion”). Within the Districts’ Motion, the Districts attached and requested approval of the “First Addendum,” which would add the Big Lost River Ground Water District (“BLRGWD”), Upper Big Lost Ground River Water District (“UBLRGWD”), and Little Lost River Ground Water District (“LLRGWD”) (collectively, the “Joining Districts”) to the 2024 Plan. Motion, at 2–3. Additionally, the Districts’ Motion requested a temporary stay of

# Page 2^page=2
ORDER GRANTING LIMITED INTERVENTION TO UBLRGWD; ORDER GRANTING IN PART JOINT MOTION FOR TEMPORARY STAY OF CURTAILMENT—2 curtailment of ground water rights held by patrons of the Joining Districts under the SWC Delivery Call, assigned Department Docket No. CM-DC-2010-001, pending resolution concerning the approval of the First Addendum. Id., at 2. On April 15, 2026, the Director held a status conference in CM-MP-2024-003 regarding the First Addendum to the 2024 Plan.1 On April 16, 2026, the Director issued an Order Granting Limited Intervention to BLRGWD and LLRGWD, Striking IGWA’s Filings from the Record, Denying the Districts’ and BLRGWD’s Motion for Temporary Stay of Curtailment, and Establishing a Technical Working Group; Notice of Status Conference (“April 16th Order”). The April 16th Order documented the Director’s granting of BLRGWD and LLRGWD’s oral petitions to intervene during the status conference in CM-MP-2024-003. However, the Director limited their participation “to issues related to the First Addendum.” April 16th Order, at 4. Additionally, in the April 16th Order, noting a lack of consensus among the parties and a lack of authority cited, the Director denied the Districts’ motion to temporarily stay curtailment of the ground water rights held by patrons of the Joining Districts pending Department action on the First Addendum. Id. On April 17, 2026, UBLRGWD filed an Unopposed Motion for Limited Intervention (“Unopposed Motion”), requesting limited intervention in CM-MP-2024-003, consistent with the Director’s order granting limited intervention to BLRGWD and LLRGWD to participate in the matter concerning issues related to the First Addendum. Unopposed Motion, at 1. UBLRGWD states in its motion that its counsel “discussed this intervention with counsel for all other parties in the matter April 16, 2026 with no one opposing said intervention . . . .” Unopposed Motion at 2. Also on April 17, 2026, the SWC, Districts, and Joining Districts filed with the Director a Joint Motion to Approve Stipulation to Stay Curtailment in the Big Lost River Basin and the Little Lost River Basin (“Joint Motion to Stay Curtailment”). ANALYSIS REGARDING INTERVENTION Rule 350 of the Department’s Rules of Procedure allows a non-party to a contested case who has a direct and substantial interest in the proceeding to petition to intervene as a party. IDAPA 37.01.01.350. The Unopposed Motion does not identify the UBLRGWD’s direct and substantial interest in the proceeding as required by Rule 351. IDAPA 37.01.01.351. Even so, the Director finds it appropriate to grant the Unopposed Motion. As a Joining District, the UBLRGWD is similarly situated to the BLRGWD and LLRGWD. The direct and substantial interests of the Joining Districts was discussed during the April 15, 2026 status conference. No party to the CM-MP-2024-003 proceedings opposes UBLRGWD’s limited intervention. Unopposed Motion at 2. Based on the foregoing, the Director finds that the UBLRGWD possesses a direct and substantial interest sufficient to support limited intervention. Accordingly, the Director should grant the UBLRGWD’s Unopposed Motion. 1 Before the conference, the SWC emailed the Director asserting that they would not sign off on the First Addendum as it was filed with the Department. Not. of Status Conf., at 1.

ORDER GRANTING LIMITED INTERVENTION TO UBLRGWD; ORDER GRANTING IN PART JOINT MOTION FOR TEMPORARY STAY OF CURTAILMENT—3 ANALYSIS REGARDING MOTION TO STAY CURTAILMENT The December 8, 2025 Curtailment Order curtailed all ground water rights within the ESPA ACGWS with priority dates junior to August 15, 1952. Curtailment Order, at 4. At that time, the ESPA ACGWS included portions of the Big Lost River and Little Lost River Basins. The Joint Motion to Stay Curtailment asks the Director “stay curtailment” in the Big Lost River and Little Lost River Basins through May 4, 2026. Joint Motion to Stay Curtailment, at 2. Because all parties to CM-MP-2024-003, including the calling party, the SWC, stipulated to a temporary stay of curtailment through May 4, 2026, the Director will grant the requested stay, but only as to ground water users who are members of the Joining Districts. Ground water users who are not members of the Joining Districts should remain subject to curtailment. ORDER Based upon and consistent with the foregoing, IT IS HEREBY ORDERED: That the Upper Big Lost Ground Water District is GRANTED LIMITED INTERVENTION. Its participation in this matter is limited to issues relating to the First Addendum. IT IS FURTHER ORDERED: That the Joint Motion to Stay Curtailment in the Big Lost River Basin and the Little Lost River Basin, filed April 17, 2026, is GRANTED IN PART. Effective immediately, the December 8, 2025 curtailment order is stayed as to those junior ground water users who: 1. Are located within the Big Lost River Basin or the Little Lost River Basin; 2. Are subject to the December 8, 2025 Final Order Curtailing Ground Water Rights Junior to August 15, 1952; and 3. Are members of Big Lost River Ground Water District, Upper Big Lost River Ground Water District, or Little Lost River Ground Water District. This stay shall remain in effect through May 4, 2026. Dated this 17th day of April 2026. _________________________________________ MATHEW WEAVER Director
